about:
Wholesale Industrial Electronics (WIE) is a privately owned electronics distributor headquartered in North Charleston, South Carolina. Founded in 1948, the company has grown steadily by supplying electronic components and systems at competitive prices.

The company distributes a broad range of products across three main categories: industrial automation (including PLCs, drives, power supplies, sensors, and relays), data and networking (patch cables, Cat5/6 wire, wireless routers, home automation), and security products (cameras, DVRs, monitors, accessories). WIE maintains four stocking locations across South Carolina and Georgia and operates as a member and owner of Edge, a national distributor group that expands its inventory reach. Its staff includes factory-trained application engineers who assist customers with designing and implementing solutions ranging from motor control centers to multi-camera security systems.

WIE serves a diverse customer base spanning manufacturing, military, federal and state government, industrial, healthcare, educational, commercial, and contractor markets. The company emphasizes its ability to supply military-spec products and European-manufactured components alongside standard industrial electronics.

WIE differentiates itself through its employees' deep product knowledge gained from extensive factory training, a commitment to total customer satisfaction, and the resources of the Edge network for extensive inventory selection and local service.
